text_block_list.text:
Heheh... It's race time, Trainer.
I'm totally ready to roll.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"This pre-race tension is irresistible...!
I'm itching to get out there and run already."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Leave it to me!
I'll blow past every single one of 'em—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna burn the coolest image of me ever
crossing the finish line in 1st place right into your eyes!!
